name: Isotridecyl C16-18 fatty acids esters
description: Isotridecyl C16-18 fatty acids esters (CAS 95912-88-2 ), commercially available as Radia 7513, is a synthetic ester produced from isotridecanol and C16-18 fatty acids. It functions as a lubricant base fluid and plasticizer across industrial formulations. This chemical is preferred where oxidative stability and low volatility are procurement priorities. In metalworking and industrial lubrication, it serves as a base or co-base fluid in cutting fluids, hydraulic oils, and gear lubricants. The ester is highly valued in applications where biodegradability and thermal stability are required. Coatings formulators incorporate it as a plasticizing additive to improve film flexibility and substrate adhesion without compromising durability. In adhesives and sealants, it acts as a softener to adjust rheology and extend open time in both hot-melt and solvent-based systems. Polymer and elastomer compounders use it to improve processability and flexibility in PVC and rubber compounds. Isotridecyl C16-18 fatty acids esters is supplied as a clear liquid. It is available in technical grade , the standard specification for industrial lubricant, coatings, and polymer applications. Bulk supply is typical in drums and IBC containers, with tanker quantities available for large-volume industrial buyers.
